incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: prod-api-5xx-rate spike > 15m threshold (svc: api-gateway) — paging oncall

maya: I'm on it, grabbing context. Which regions?

sam: seeing 5xx spike from edge in us-east-1, surge around 23:12 UTC. Error types: 502/503 and a bunch of upstream timeout 504.

jordan: that's our route v2 rollout to split traffic to model-pool-b. I just pushed a routing weight tweak ~23:05.

maya: deploy-bot, can you confirm any recent LB/Envoy config changes?

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-15T23:05:12Z by jordan — config: /infra/envoy/routes.yaml modified (route: /v1/stream -> new cluster model-pool-b weight 30 -> model-pool-a weight 70). No pod restarts.

sam: logs show rapid 5xx from envoy cluster upstream healthcheck failing, and retries piling up. I think retry policy + new weight shifted traffic to a smaller pool which tripped circuit-breakers.

maya: paste of envoy logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T23:12:08Z] envoy upstream reset: connection failure, uri: /v1/stream, response_code: 502
[2026-03-15T23:12:08Z] attempted retry (policy: 3), upstream reset: timeout
[2026-03-15T23:12:09Z] cluster model-pool-b health: unhealthy (outlier detection tripped)
```

jordan: ugh — I forgot we still have lower capacity on pool-b after the last maintenance. I can revert the weight immediately.

elliot: quick mitigation options: 1) roll back route weight to previous (immediate), 2) disable retries at edge for this route (short-term), 3) bump circuit-breaker max connections for pool-b (requires cluster reload).

maya: do rollback now, + disable retries at edge for /v1/stream while we confirm. Sam, can you run the CLI to change the listener config?

sam: running: `rbxctl envoy patch-route --service api-gateway --path /v1/stream --set weights: [model-pool-a:90,model-pool-b:10]` — applying...

sam: applied. also applying retries off: `rbxctl envoy patch-route --service api-gateway --path /v1/stream --set retry_policy: none`

ops-bot: route patch accepted, config xds push started, rolling update to edge proxies triggered.

maya: seeing 5xx rate dropping in us-east-1 30s after change. p50 latency stable, p95 improving.

jordan: opening revert CL to entirely remove the weight change and add a checklist to coordinate capacity next time: `git revert infra/envoy/routes.yaml@d3f9a`

maya: customer impact: Hosted API calls to /v1/stream experienced ~18% error rate during 23:05-23:13 UTC window in us-east; global traffic about ~3% error increase. Logged top affected customers: cust-phi (support pinged) and cust-zeta (auto-retry client).

sam: monitoring will keep high-frequency sampling for 1h. I'll add an alert if 5xx > 1% for 10m.

elliot: follow-up actions: 1) revert commit (jordan) 2) add canary capacity check in rollout playbook (eng-runtime) 3) make retries opt-in per cluster for now 4) add pre-rollout canary traffic test (devex + eng-platform).

maya: i'm handing off to night oncall @sam on duty. Sam — take the pager for 2h, then update postmortem draft. :thumbsup:

sam: got it. I'll start the postmortem skeleton in #postmortems and tag owners. Anyone else?

jordan: I'll document the incident notes and the revert CL link. Sorry team.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by maya. On-call changed to sam at 23:18 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident severity: Sev3 -> investigating. Closed to monitoring at 23:20 UTC after mitigation held.
